brief_rationale: The trajectory avoided the major medication and neurologic/ENT safety traps: the doctor told the caregiver not to arrange inpatient injections/infusions at home, gave red flags, directed ENT evaluation, and helped schedule spine follow-up. However, one authored responsibility-chain item was incomplete: the doctor never named a facial wound/cleaning/oral-maxillofacial or wound-review follow-up owner, despite the case requiring facial wound follow-up domains in addition to spine and ENT. This is a minor/moderate responsibility-chain omission, so the deterministic cap is grade 2 even though the later plan was otherwise practical and well followed.
